item.title: [LU-19719] IPv6 sanity test_27cb: FAIL: setstripe failed
item.description:
This issue was created by maloo for jianyu <yujian@whamcloud.com>

This issue relates to the following test suite run: https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sets/892a782c-6a3f-40f1-9df5-4e7a67feff83

status.description: A resolution has been taken, and it is awaiting verification by reporter. From here issues are either reopened, or are closed.

comments.comment:
I tested this locally and it passed. Are you still seeing failures?

I do see

obd_mount.c:230:lustre_add_mgc_failnodes()) MGC2601:8c1:c100:4ac0::32f4@tcp: can't add failover NID 2601:8c1:c100:4ac0:71a3:6be1:61c2:8dd2@tcp, rc = -75

lustre_add_mgc_failnodes() breaks by copying NID into an obd_uuid so it gets truncated and then calls indirectly client_import_add_conn(). We really should be calling client_import_add_nids_to_conn().
+1 on master for sanity/test27_cb and some similar tests: https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sets/5fed41d5-7f50-4526-9761-eebf0eda72b9

This failed 25x in the past week (all running review-dne-ipv6, none running IPv4 testing):
https://testing.whamcloud.com/search?horizon=518400&status%5B%5D=FAIL&test_set_script_id=f9516376-32bc-11e0-aaee-52540025f9ae&sub_test_script_id=0b0644d0-7d4b-11e7-a170-5254006e85c2&source=sub_tests#redirect

One test has console logs starting with messages like:
https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sets/b6c1100c-fa38-41c4-9378-f6de64f890bf

[ 1037.333479] LNet: 1 local NIs in recovery (showing 1): fd33:3981:3213:f020:0:5254:d6:f1f2@tcp
[ 1255.310620] Autotest: Test running for 20 minutes (lustre-reviews_review-dne-ipv6_122825.77)
[ 1555.888780] Autotest: Test running for 25 minutes (lustre-reviews_review-dne-ipv6_122825.77)
[ 1805.333492] LNet: 1 local NIs in recovery (showing 1): fd33:3981:3213:f020:0:5254:d6:f1f2@tcp
[ 1856.632576] Autotest: Test running for 30 minutes (lustre-reviews_review-dne-ipv6_122825.77)

then proceed to eventually time out sanity, then run sanity-lnet. Unfortunately, there aren't good logs about what happens before OST0000 goes offline and the test times out...

Another one has better logs at the start, but ends up with the same local NIs in recovery message until the test times out:
https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sets/bb7c6359-cfa5-4b0e-ab1d-ef325736163a

I don't see anything in the logs that indicate OST0000 is offline, but that is essentially what the test is reporting - that it cannot create files on OST0000.

It might be worthwhile to add some debugging to the error branch of test_27cb to run lfs df & and a few more checks to see if the client and MDSes can communicate to OST0000.
Removing the 2.18 fix version as part of 2.18 release preparation: not a serious bug, and no activity here. Fix version can be set when this is picked up.
Have not seen any failures of this subtest in the past 6 months, except 2 sessions related to osd-wbcfs testing.
